2610.11907.title: Beyond Visual Enhancement: Adaptive Multi-Context Steering to Mitigate LVLM Hallucinations
2610.11907.paper_summary: Hallucination remains a significant challenge in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). Existing training-free methods generally mitigate hallucinations through contrastive decoding or visual enhancement, often increasing the relative influence of visual evidence during generation. This raises a fundamental question: Can LVLMs dynamically regulate the contributions of different context sources to suppress hallucinations? In this work, we investigate and quantify how LVLMs coordinate multiple context sources during decoding and examine how this intrinsic behavior can guide hallucination mitigation. We find that LVLMs exhibit an intrinsic vision-attending tendency that can guide adaptive visual steering, while textual contexts can also contribute to hallucination mitigation. Motivated by these findings, we propose AIMS (Adaptive Information Multi-source Steering), a lightweight training-free framework that adaptively coordinates visual, prefilled textual, and generated contexts during decoding. Specifically, AIMS constructs compact prototypes for the three context domains and estimates their affinities with the current query to determine head-wise steering weights. The resulting multi-source steering direction is applied to the query representation, enabling adaptive context integration without additional model training or auxiliary forward passes. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and decoding strategies demonstrate that AIMS effectively mitigates object hallucination while maintaining competitive general-purpose multimodal capabilities.
2610.11907.paper_summary_zh: 幻覺仍然是大型視覺-語言模型（LVLMs）的一個重大挑戰。現有的無需訓練的方法通常通過對比解碼或視覺增強來減輕幻覺，這往往在生成過程中增加視覺證據的相對影響力。這引發了一個基本問題：LVLMs 能否動態調節不同上下文來源的貢獻以抑制幻覺？在這項工作中，我們研究並量化 LVLMs 在解碼過程中如何協調多個上下文來源，並檢查這種內在行為如何指導幻覺的減輕。我們發現 LVLMs 表現出一種內在的視覺注意傾向，可以指導自適應的視覺引導，而文本上下文也可以對減輕幻覺有所貢獻。基於這些發現，我們提出了 AIMS（自適應信息多源引導），這是一個輕量級的無需訓練的框架，能夠在解碼過程中自適應地協調視覺、預填文本和生成的上下文。具體而言，AIMS 為三個上下文領域構建緊湊的原型，並根據當前查詢估計它們的親和力，以確定頭部引導權重。生成的多源引導方向應用於查詢表示，實現自適應上下文整合，而無需額外的模型訓練或輔助前向傳遞。對多個 LVLMs 和解碼策略的廣泛實驗表明，AIMS 有效減輕了物體幻覺，同時保持了具有競爭力的通用多模態能力。
